title: Novel tyrosinol-based chiral stationary phase for the separation of tetracyclic quinolines active as PXR agonists: Investigating the enantiorecognition mechanism through molecular dynamics.
authors: Labikova, Magdalena; Cerra, Bruno; Di Michele, Alessandro; Gioiello, Antimo; Ianni, Federica; Sardella, Roccaldo; Carotti, Andrea; Kohout, Michal
one_liner_zh: 该文研究酪氨酸醇类手性固定相分离PXR激动剂四环喹啉的对映体识别机制，虽用分子动力学模拟，但核心是手性色谱分离而非蛋白质-DNA互作，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: In recent years, a wide range of chiral molecules has been investigated as potential selectors (SOs) for enantiomeric separation in liquid chromatography, which remains a key tool in the development of new enantiomerically pure pharmaceuticals. SOs encompass diverse chemical and structural classes, from low-molecular-weight molecules to synthetic and biological polymers, many of which are already commercially available. Despite the abundance of commercial chiral stationary phases (CSPs), the demand for novel and more versatile materials remains high. RESULTS: In this study, we present the design and synthesis of a novel tyrosinol-based CSP and its application in separating tetracyclic tetrahydroquinoline derivatives that act as pregnane X receptor agonists. The new CSP demonstrated high enantioselectivity and chemoselectivity under alkane-alcohol (normal-phase) conditions, enabling baseline resolution of all investigated analytes. The enantiomeric elution order (EEO) was unambiguously determined by combining semipreparative-scale chromatography with electronic circular dichroism (ECD) spectroscopy and time-dependent density functional theory calculations. This integrated approach allowed reliable stereochemical assignment of all separated enantiomers and confirmed the consistency of the EEO across the studied series. Complementary molecular dynamics simulations provided mechanistic insight into enantiorecognition, revealing hydrogen bonding as the primary interaction driving enantioselectivity, with pi-pi and pi-cation contacts contributing in a substituent-dependent manner. SIGNIFICANCE: Overall, the study highlights the potential of tyrosine-derived selectors as versatile CSPs and demonstrates the added value of combining experimental and computational methods to unravel enantiorecognition mechanisms.
abstract_zh: 背景：近年来，多种手性分子已被研究作为液相色谱中对映体分离的潜在选择剂（SOs），液相色谱仍是开发新型对映体纯药物的重要工具。SOs涵盖多种化学和结构类别，从低分子量分子到合成和生物聚合物，其中许多已商业化供应。尽管手性固定相（CSPs）种类丰富，但对新型且更具通用性材料的需求仍然很高。结果：在本研究中，我们展示了一种新型基于酪氨醇的CSP的设计与合成，及其在分离作为孕烷X受体激动剂的四环四氢喹啉衍生物中的应用。该新型CSP在烷烃-醇（正相）条件下表现出高对映选择性和化学选择性，能够对所有分析物实现基线分离。对映体洗脱顺序（EEO）通过结合半制备规模色谱、电子圆二色（ECD）光谱和时间依赖密度泛函理论计算明确确定。这种综合方法使得所有分离对映体的立体化学归属可靠，并确认了所研究系列中EEO的一致性。补充的分子动力学 (molecular dynamics) 模拟提供了对映体识别的机制见解，揭示氢键是驱动对映选择性的主要相互作用，而π-π和π-阳离子接触以取代基依赖的方式贡献。意义：总体而言，本研究强调了酪氨酸衍生选择剂作为通用CSP的潜力，并展示了结合实验和计算方法以阐明对映体识别机制的附加价值。
